The '''T2-26 Scout Walker''' was a [[Walker/Legends|Walker]] used during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref>[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]</ref>

==Behind the Scenes==
The T2-26 Scout Walker was released on 10 March 2026 as a Twitch Drop alongside game update 7.8.1 "Master's Enigma" as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''.<ref>{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20260331|text=Executive Producer Letter - Q1 2026}}</ref>
